headline: Nivedan Churiwal files SEBI Regulation 31(4) disclosure for BSL Limited stake acquisition
sum: Nivedan Churiwal has filed a mandatory Regulation 31(4) disclosure under SEBI's Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers Regulations, 2011, signalling a material stake acquisition in BSL Limited requiring exchange notification.
implication: Regulation 31(4) filings trigger public disclosure obligations when acquirers cross regulatory thresholds (typically 5% onwards); this signals either threshold breach or an open offer trigger, requiring verification of concert party status and open offer mechanics under the 2011 Takeover Code.
detail: Nivedan Churiwal has submitted a formal disclosure to the NSE under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This filing is a mandatory requirement when an acquirer or group crosses prescribed thresholds in share ownership. The disclosure has been archived in the NSE corporate registry, confirming filing but the exact stake percentage, consideration value and deal structure require cross-reference with the full regulatory filing or subsequent announcements.
